what: Buyer raised a case on Etsy for an undelivered order but the website's case system was broken — pressing buttons redirected in a loop between the order page and the case page; buyer eventually recovered money by raising a PayPal case instead.
verbatim_snippet: "Update 24/11/2025: Today I received an email from Etsy to raise a Case for the order #3863799705 however following the link in the email or by opening the order on the web site I am unable to open a Case. When I press the open Case button it redirects me to the Order page and if I press the help with the order page it redirects me back to the Open Case page. It is impossible. In the meantime I have raised a case with Paypal."
notes: Trustpilot etsy.co.uk profile page 4; not confirmed directly fetched. Buyer eventually recovered funds via PayPal. Describes a specific UX bug in Etsy's dispute resolution interface. Purchase outcome: refunded via PayPal, not Etsy.
